name: Final Cut Pro
note: Every row of Apple's "Keyboard shortcuts in Final Cut Pro for Mac" page. The action name is Apple's own command name (the Command column of that page) and the context is the command set the page groups it under (Application, Editing, Effects, General, Marking, Organization, Playback and navigation, Share and tools, View, Windows); rows whose description says the shortcut applies while editing a text field carry the context "While editing a text field" instead. Apple writes "Delete" for the backspace key, which is written here as Backspace. Final Cut Pro is macOS only, so only "mac" is filled in. Where Apple prints an alternative in parentheses only the primary form is kept: "Go to Beginning" / "Go to End" keep Home / End and drop the Fn-Left Arrow / Fn-Right Arrow alternatives, and "Add Caption" keeps Option-C and drops the Control-Option-C form used while the caption editor is open. One row is left out entirely: the Playback and navigation set lists Play Reverse twice (J and Shift-Space bar), and only J, the first listed, is kept because the two would collide on name and context.
